Voat! I'm just learning CSS and trying to figure some things out... How could you make the table, I'll call it a table, transparent on your subverse?

I'm gonna assume that by table you mean the main content area, so thats what I'll use in some example code, but the CSS should work for any part of the page. If you are trying to set a background color or image for the page, and then have the content be transparent on top of it, the CSS should be something like this

body {
 background:(url:[your image here]);
}
#container {
 rgba(255,255,255,0.0);
}

rgba(x,y,z,a) allows you to set the color of something including transparency. The first value is the red value, from 0-255, second is the green value, third is blue, and last is the Alpha value, or how transparent it is. This is on a scale of 0-1, 0 being completely transparent, 1 being completely opaque, and decimals being used to specify a value in between.

I dont know if that will clear up your question, but let me know if you need anymore help
